purpose: Exploratory controls on the already inspected development bug; not calibration or held-out evaluation
stopping: No affordable action, cap, nonpositive selection score, or a Full top-1 strictly above every remaining raw L1 score. Highest suspicion also stops below the existing 0.50 suspicion threshold. This is an uncalibrated heuristic, not a correctness certificate.
disagreement: range of three censored rank percentiles: observed r/(depth+1), missing=1; per-ranker depth recorded independently
ambiguity: mean of adjacent-score closeness, prior/current rank movement, normalized rank-signal dispersion, top-1/top-5 boundary proximity, and reported L1 uncertainty; no probabilities
